notes.title: ⚔️ v0.61 Update Notice
notes.content:
Hello!
Here are the update notes.

*Start Screen Update
The start screen has been redesigned to look cleaner.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/c3479f1ca5f1001c583c830a35ee0dca880eeb3c.gif

The previous start screen emphasized party play,
but this time it has been adjusted to highlight the feeling of dungeon exploration.

*Hit Impact Adjustments
Hit effects and hit-stop have been added/adjusted.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/498ff8d6515a81aa7626941d0a78c96f31ad0af2.gif

*Since this game is a 4-player belt-scroll action,
making effects too flashy can actually reduce readability.

After various experiments, we have applied impact effects that fit this version.*

*Party Window
The way the UI is called has been changed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/07a2fa957bf36e6fc742799f58dc51d757f4d656.gif

The party info window no longer shows details immediately.
Instead, details are displayed only after pressing the select button.

This reflects feedback that too much information was being injected.
Now details are provided more naturally after a confirmation step.

*Basic Feat Adjustments
The early feats provided have been revised to focus on straightforward, stat-related effects.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/67a7dbca49abcfb3755c2a012a6b6fd9f7011592.gif

Previously, most of the starting feats were based on brands or conditional effects,
which made growth feel unintuitive.
We determined that giving conditional feats too early was a design mistake.

The newly added feats are as follows:

Attack
Increases Attack Power by (2% / 4% / 6% / 8% / 10%).

Follow-Up
On a successful attack, deal an additional (5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 25) fixed damage.

Rapid Strikes
Increases Attack Speed by (3% / 6% / 9% / 12% / 15%).

Amplify
Increases Critical Damage by (6% / 12% / 18% / 24% / 30%).

Finisher Slash
Basic attacks have an 8% chance to inflict Bleed for 6 seconds, dealing (6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / 30) damage.

Defensive Stance
Increases Defense by (2% / 4% / 6% / 8% / 10%).

Dampen
Reduces incoming damage by (1 / 1 / 2 / 2 / 3).

Retribution
When taking damage, deal (10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50) Thorn damage to nearby enemies.

Wave of Protection
Every 10 seconds, grants a shield of (1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5) for 3 seconds.

Mindset
When using an Ultimate, grants a shield of (1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5) for 3 seconds.

Indomitable Resistance
When stunned by a Large Monster’s Roar, reduces stun duration by (20% / 40% / 60% / 80% / 100%) and grants a shield of (2 / 4 / 6 / 8 / 10) for 3 seconds.

Endurance
Increases Endurance by (7 / 14 / 21 / 28 / 35).

Cooldown Reduction
Reduces all skill cooldowns by (3% / 6% / 9% / 12% / 15%).

Weakening Strike
On hit, has an 8% chance to inflict Weakness for 6 seconds, causing the enemy to take (2% / 4% / 6% / 8% / 10%) more damage.

Encouragement
When healing an ally (other than self), their Attack Speed increases by (2% / 4% / 6% / 8% / 10%) for 6 seconds.

*Dash Added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/b769626acd4f6173c2abac349cd01831d0378a3f.gif
Double-tap a direction to dash.
Attacking during a dash performs an Evasion Attack.
Pressing the evade key during a dash triggers a Super Dash, allowing for a longer dodge.

In older versions, “slow walk, walk, and dash” were all implemented,
but dash was removed for readability in 4-player play.
Re-adding dash made the gameplay feel much more active, which we confirmed as a positive change.

*Arcade Mode Preview
The upcoming Arcade Mode will be separate from the main game.
Levels and starting gear will be reset,
and like an arcade game, you’ll just pick a character and play until clear.
It will be playable solo or with 2 players, without visiting the outpost.

If you have any special feedback, please leave a comment or join Discord. Thank you!

Come hang out on Discord!

🎉 Thank you!

notes.title: ⚔️ v0.5 Update: Endless Dungeon "Night of the Gatekeeper" & New Systems
notes.content:
⚔️ v0.5 Update: Endless Dungeon "Night of the Gatekeeper" & New Systems

Hello, here’s the update announcement.
It’s been a while, but we’ve added a new dungeon.

Starting with this update, we’ll be adding a new dungeon every week.😊

🕛 New Dungeon: Night of the Gatekeeper (Endless Mode)
The new dungeon Night of the Gatekeeper has been added.

Every 5 stages, a boss will appear. Defeating the boss will drop one of six unique weapons and a gear chest.

Soul Crystals can now be earned faster relative to playtime.

At stages 10 and 15, the tier of unique gear and the number of gear chests will continue to increase.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/f931a4326e6861e2be94ec1b42596880635f5301.gif
You can now experience the dream battle of fighting 3 bosses at once!🐉

Each stage has a 45-second time limit. Failure to defeat enemies within the time limit ends the dungeon.

Time attack rankings are recorded up to Stage 15.

While Stage 15 is the baseline (recorded for time attack), you can continue clearing beyond that to obtain even higher-quality uniques and gear.

You can enter the dungeon by talking to the corresponding NPC in the garrison.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/f2dd3d578e7935fa1434c356b1db503ecb142015.png

🧪 New Weapons & Feats

🗡️ Venom Fang (Sword)
[Aerial Bombardment]
If you successfully attack while airborne, inflicts 5/10/15/20/25 poison damage over 6 seconds.

🗡️ Sprouting Blade (Greatsword)
[Blood Reclaim]
Attacking a poisoned enemy restores 1/2/3/4/5 HP per level. (Cooldown: 6 sec)

🔨 Mace of Judgment (Hammer)
[Brand of Frailty]
Attacking an enemy with 40% or less HP increases their damage taken by 2/4/6/8/10% for 8 seconds.

🛡️ Thorns of the Earth (Lance)
[Piercing Thorns]
Thorn damage deals an additional 0.2%/0.4%/0.6%/0.8%/1% of the enemy’s max HP.

🏹 Rain of the Sky (Bow)
[Endless Pressure]
Deals 8/16/24/32/40 fixed damage to enemies in the Frail state (increased damage taken).

🪄 Gaze of the Abyss (Staff)
[Echo of Submission]
Successful attacks against taunted enemies deal an additional 3%/6%/9%/12%/15% damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/6fc02f1872c7a1ad730eb90ec36e8736dc556906.png
These items can only be obtained in the Night of the Gatekeeper dungeon.

🔥 New Feature
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/40dc367a8a48b0f61c2df7099a987398644658e0.gif
You can now purchase EXP using Soul Crystals. (-45 / +EXP 500)
Non-controlled party members can also level up using Soul Crystals via the Type B Party Management screen.

🔥 Equipment UI Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/842831eb854d0c9e4a783a59db22cfc8a30f0116.png
The equipment change screen now makes it easier to view basic gear information.
It also shows general feat effects and whether the item has been appraised.

🎉 Thank you always for your feedback!

notes.title: 🛠️ Feedback-Based System Update (v0.496)
notes.content:
We participated in BIC 2025, the largest indie game event in Korea.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/723405cfc62af4ab8814872349214cf06107f3b6.png
Based on feedback from the demo, we’ve updated various areas including combat effects, system UI, skill text, and overall visibility.

🎯 Combat Visual Effects Improvement
When defeating an elite monster, a unique visual effect now plays to enhance the sense of impact.
Hit guides have been added to the face and legs of large monsters, making it easier to target their weak points.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/e39321b83ad8baacd2e5616b32a2a818fd87bb7d.png
If a monster has special traits such as knockback immunity or status effect immunity, they are now displayed beneath the HP bar.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/3d2ab9358873fcd717d775f42eb7ea569a7a3d4d.png

⚔️ Skill and Brand System Overhaul
Skill-related attributes are now referred to uniformly as “Brands” to reduce confusion with elemental properties.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/ca5333683c884c3e33a23f10163c63739d5d3c1c.png
Skill icons now include visual indicators showing whether the skill is Offensive, Defensive, or Utility.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/c1d32d6c69a5780c8ca120ee8a4f634721b41147.png
When using a taunt skill, the affected monster will become temporarily immune to CC (crowd control) effects.

🧩 UI and Tactical System Enhancements
The party member swap UI has been further refined to provide more detailed and intuitive information.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/161197fec775ef849e0a51770caa5828ce60818e.png

🌀 New Focus Attack UI Trigger Conditions
When your combo count exceeds 15 or the Party Gauge exceeds 50%,
the Focus Attack UI will automatically activate.

🪶 Simple Mode Added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/efb436fd5521f170bc6a79105167f28de0382f2a.png
When enabled, Simple Mode hides all party members’ HP bars and damage meters,
ideal for players who prefer a cleaner screen and better combat focus.
You can toggle this mode off in the settings to return to the standard view.

Thank you always!

notes.title: ⚔️ New Advanced Classes & Enhanced Basic Attacks Update (Final Knight v0.4)⚔
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/fca902a5fecc1ea475170d2f61f9a267953077db.png

🧬 New Advanced Class Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/b3fa84b4064d9cfe6f577e85eb0886cd6e41bd5b.gif

Previously, you would gain your base class’s special ability at level 5, and unlock an advanced class at level 10.
However, reaching level 10 took quite a bit of playtime.
So we’ve added a new mid-tier advanced class unlocked at level 7 to bridge the gap.

✨ Advanced Class Update 🎉 Enjoy +50% EXP 📈 for 2 weeks starting today!

🎯 Gladiator - Fighter
The Gladiator’s attacks have +15% critical hit chance when striking enemies targeting them.
If the enemy has 15% or less HP remaining, critical damage increases by up to 25%.
When attacked, the Gladiator stuns the attacker for 2 seconds and reflects physical damage equal to Max HP × 5.

🛡️ Crusader - Paladin
If the Crusader has at least 30% HP, whenever an ally takes damage, the Crusader reduces it by 3, but loses 1 HP themselves.

🪨 Stone Shaman - Hammerer
All magic damage dealt is increased by 15%.
After using 3 skills, the next one creates a magic zone for 8 seconds that deals damage every second equal to HP × 1.1 to enemies within 5M.
This magic deals double damage to stunned enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/fae138c0a4934c92605235df19010cfe103fc1c1.gif

🔪 Painbringer - Black Guard
Enemies targeting the Painbringer take 15% more damage.
Every 4 seconds, the Painbringer inflicts 1 Wound stack to enemies within 5M.

☠️ Venom Strider - Ranger
15% of the Venom Strider’s skill damage is converted into poison damage over 5 seconds and stacks.
Poisoned enemies take an additional 25% damage.

🔥 High Arbiter - Wizard
Ultimate skill damage increases by 35%.
Each basic attack hit reduces the ultimate’s cooldown by 8%.

💀 Chaos Lord - Barbarian
Each Wound stack on an enemy increases damage dealt by 3%.
If the Chaos Lord has 100+ Stamina, this bonus doubles.
With 5 or more Wound stacks, an extra 15% bonus damage is applied.

🙏 Ascetic - Cleric
The lower the Ascetic’s HP, the higher their attack power.
At 30% HP or less, attack speed and physical damage increase by up to 50%.
Cannot be knocked down when damaged.

💃 Cruel Dancer - Rogue
When Cruel Dancer attacks an enemy’s arms or legs, 25% of the damage becomes poison damage over 5 seconds.
This poison damage increases by 5% per Wound stack on the enemy.

⚠️ Advanced classes are not always stronger — they are more like alternate combat styles.
You can check all details in the in-game Codex.

📏 Advanced Class Stat Adjustments
Based on new class usage data, stat balances and special traits for advanced classes have been adjusted.

🗡️ Basic Attack Enhancements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/c07faf556b376bfaadf4962c8b219ae597f426c0.gif

Basic attacks now come with unique effects.
Especially, the final hits often grant bonus damage or survival benefits.

⚔️ Fighter Tree
The Fighter slashes 4 times, dealing physical damage.
The fourth attack deals 50% more damage to downed enemies.
If it hits, the Fighter gains 25 Stamina.

🛡️ Paladin Tree
The Paladin swings a greatsword 3 times to deal physical damage.
The third strike gains an additional 15% critical hit chance.

🔨 Hammerer Tree
The Hammerer strikes twice for physical damage.
The third strike slams the hammer down for magic damage and stuns nearby enemies.
It deals 50% bonus damage to enemies already stunned.

⚔️ Black Guard Tree
The Black Guard strikes forward three times for physical damage.
The third hit deals double damage. Enemies hit at the tip of the spear take an extra 50% damage.

🏹 Ranger Tree
The Ranger fires three arrows forward, dealing magic damage.
If the third arrow hits the first party member it touches, they recover 1 HP.

🔥 Wizard Tree
The Wizard fires random fireballs to deal magic damage.
Each time a basic attack is used, gain 1 shield for 3 seconds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/857c2c4e61d462c9a2ba504336daf2307ed7caa3.gif

💪 Barbarian Tree
The Barbarian slashes 3 times, dealing physical damage.
The third strike deals additional damage equal to current Stamina.

🕊️ Cleric Tree
The Cleric swings a hammer four times for physical damage.
If the fourth attack hits, it reduces the cooldown of the ultimate by 0.5 seconds.

🗡️ Rogue Tree
The Rogue deals a series of physical strikes.
The second attack stuns for 5 seconds.
The fourth attack launches enemies into the air.
The fourth attack also deals 5% bonus damage per Wound stack on the enemy.

🔧 Miscellaneous Balance Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/04f66815cb92df0600f3c3255f175bc074b748f5.gif
Damage-over-time and Taunt status effects are now clearly visible.
Damage ratios are displayed accurately.

Interaction is now performed using the Attack1 key or Gamepad A button.

You now pick up items or interact with the UI differently.
This change helps prevent accidental use of the second skill due to interaction glitches.

🐛 Bug Fixes

Fixed a freeze when selecting Black Dragon in the Monster Codex.

Fixed an issue where gems weren’t awarded when upgrading Class Mastery.

Fixed an issue where mastery progression for advanced classes didn’t apply properly.

Fixed NPC reward bug.

Fixed issue where reaching max Bond value would halt progression.

🌟 Elemental Types Added

All characters, monsters, and skills (excluding basic attacks)

Fire / Water / Ice / Earth / Wind / Electric / Dark / Light
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/dacc95d1c0d1d9e7a2de1e09c1b072cbf0f877b4.png

⚔️ Elemental Damage Effects

1. Skill damage increases or decreases based on affinity
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/a0cb9d83081dd79830f009ce2c0c500df3111a5f.png
Each element has a strength and weakness.
As shown below, skills deal 2x damage to weaker elements
and only 50% damage to elements they are weak against.

🔥 [Fire Skill] → ❄️ Ice monster: 2x damage, 💧 Water monster: 0.5x damage
💧 [Water Skill] → 🔥 Fire monster: 2x damage, ⚡ Electric monster: 0.5x damage
❄️ [Ice Skill] → 🪨 Earth monster: 2x damage, 🔥 Fire monster: 0.5x damage
🪨 [Earth Skill] → ⚡ Electric monster: 2x damage, ❄️ Ice monster: 0.5x damage
🌪️ [Wind Skill] → 🪨 Earth monster: 2x damage, ⚡ Electric monster: 0.5x damage
⚡ [Electric Skill] → 💧 Water monster: 2x damage, 🪨 Earth monster: 0.5x damage
🌑 [Dark Skill] → 🌕 Light monster: 2x damage
🌕 [Light Skill] → 🌑 Dark monster: 2x damage

2. S.T.A.B (Same Type Attack Bonus)
If a character uses a skill that matches their element,
they deal an additional 20% damage.

Examples:
💧 Water-type character → 💧 Water skill = +20% damage
🔥 Fire-type character → 🔥 Fire skill = +20% damage

3. Incoming damage also changes based on enemy element
You take 30% less damage from weaker elements
and 50% more damage from stronger elements.

Example:

If your character is ❄️ Ice-type
→ 🪨 Earth monster hits you: 30% reduced damage
→ 🔥 Fire monster hits you: 50% increased damage

💎 8 Unique Legendary Greaves Added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/961aa9a1b56705d91a581b05f37a8b1c2e58247b.png
New legendary gear has been added,
each increasing elemental skill damage by type.

🔥 Flame Greaves: +10% Fire skill damage per level
💧 Cascade Greaves: +10% Water skill damage per level
❄️ Glacier Greaves: +10% Ice skill damage per level
🪨 Terra Greaves: +10% Earth skill damage per level
🌪️ Storm Greaves: +10% Wind skill damage per level
⚡ Volt Greaves: +10% Electric skill damage per level
🌑 Shadow Greaves: +10% Dark skill damage per level
🌕 Radiant Greaves: +10% Light skill damage per level

Thank you always for your support.

notes.title: v.0.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello. Here are the update details.  

Level-Up System  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/925fd7c25b3e1076bdd7a06e5b5b026e36e20247.png  
The experience gain and level-up system has been added.  
You can now level up to a maximum of level 12.  
Each level-up allows you to increase 5 different stats.  

Mastery System  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/fddda92005143d546736c9e4b65a791067124cf0.png  
Starting from level 2, you can allocate a Mastery Feat every 3 levels.  
Mastery options vary depending on Race, Background, and Class.  

🔥 Retaliation Warrior
🛡 When taking damage, returns 1000% of the damage received.

🧪 Alchemical Instinct
🛡 Increases total damage by 1% per healing potion held.

🔮 Arcane Lineage
🛡 Increases all magic damage by 15%.

👀 Keen Awareness
🛡 If HP is 70% or higher, reduces damage taken by 10%.

🏰 Oath of War
🛡 Base defense rate increases by 1% per class level.

❤️ Enhanced Vitality
🛡 Base HP increases by 1 + (Class Level /3).

🛡 Arcane Barrier
🛡 Shield generation increases by 1 + (Class Level /3).

🍀 Lucky Seeker
🛡 Potion discovery chance 20%, higher-tier item discovery chance 4% (Cannot stack).

⚡ Blade of Madness
🛡 Critical Damage +20% increase.

💀 Right of Souls
🛡 High chance to drop 1 + (Class Level /3) Soul Crystals upon defeating an enemy.

⏳ Indomitable Warrior
🛡 When HP reaches 0, instantly revives with 15% HP and becomes immune to damage for 3 seconds. (Cooldown: 60 seconds)

🏹 Guardian’s Resolve
🛡 When taking damage, reduces damage taken by 3% per ally within 5m (up to 12%).

💖 Endurance Manifest
🛡 Restores 1 + (Class Level /3) HP for every 150 Stamina consumed.

🛡 Thorns of Vengeance
🛡 When taking damage, deals Current Level × 10 fixed thorn damage to nearby enemies.

🧛 Life Drinker
🛡 When taking damage, restores 10% of max HP. (Cooldown: 10 seconds)

🏹 Oath of the Guardian
🛡 When healing or buffing another party member, Defense increases by 20% for 3 seconds.

🔰 Arcane Guardian
🛡 While a shield is active, Defense increases by 15%.

🔥 Relentless Striker
🛡 When using a skill, if 30 Stamina can be consumed, it is spent, and skill damage increases by 15%.

⚔ Arcane Ravager
🛡 Basic attack damage is reduced by 50%, but all critical damage increases by 35.

🎯 Battlefield Fate
🛡 When a critical hit occurs, there is a 5% chance to reset a random skill.

🌪 Storm of Destruction
🛡 On AoE skill attack, there is a 15% chance to trigger a secondary hit dealing 50% of the current damage to all affected enemies.

🗡 Assassin Warrior
🛡 When a conditional attribute attack (knockdown, stun, wound) is successful, 30% of the damage is converted into fixed poison damage over 5 seconds.

💢 Titan’s Wrath
🛡 Increases total attack power by 30% of max HP.

🌀 Sentinel's Surge
🛡 If the shield remains intact after being generated, it explodes, dealing magic damage equal to the remaining shield × 100 to nearby enemies.

🩸 Blood Pact
🛡 Absorbs 1% of total damage dealt as HP per hit, but cannot heal above 50% HP.

🚑 Battlefield Survivalist
🛡 Upon obtaining a potion, the character restores 2 HP per second for 10 seconds and increases movement speed by 40%. Increases potion discovery chance by 20% (Cannot stack).

⚡ Overwhelming Impact
🛡 Stunning a monster applies a debuff that increases damage taken by 8% for 4 seconds (8 seconds for large monsters).

🎖 Master of the Battlefield
🛡 If this character is positioned at either end of the party, all party members recover an additional 1+(Character Level/3) Stamina per second.

🔥 Arcane Brand
🛡 When a conditional attribute attack (knockdown, stun, wound) hits, the target takes 8% increased damage for 8 seconds.

🎵 Battle Hymn
🛡 When using a skill, all allies within 5m recover 1+(Character Level/3) Stamina and gain 8% increased critical rate for 5 seconds.

✨ Divine Blessing
🛡 When using an ultimate skill, all party members recover 1 + (Character Level /3) HP (Cooldown: 6 seconds).

Equipment Now Becomes Bound on Pickup  
The temporary equipment system has been removed.  
Now, all acquired equipment is immediately bound to your character.  

Item Shop  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/5fc880fcc43baf7e90c663c9071937cf1384920f.png  
You can purchase equipment using Soul Stones from an equipment merchant who appears irregularly.  

Temporary Feature Suspensions  
- **Party Member Selection Temporarily Disabled**: Due to the addition of new features, the ability to select and swap party members is temporarily under maintenance.  
- **Background Synergy Temporarily Disabled**: Character background synergies are temporarily suspended.  
- **Good/Evil Alignment System Temporarily Disabled**: The Party Gauge synergy based on character alignment is temporarily disabled.  
- **Soul Arena Temporarily Suspended**: The Soul Arena is also undergoing maintenance.  

Updated Party Gauge System  
The Party Gauge increases by 5 each time a skill is used but decreases over time, when party members are hit, or when they die.  
Depending on the Party Gauge level, damage can be increased by up to 50%.  

Instant Dismantle System  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/95583a2e0181e88674434e7cc6c70c94cafd03ab.png  
Holding the equipment pickup key over an item will now instantly dismantle it.  

Race Bonus Adjustments  
Race bonuses have been simplified.  
Background Bonus Adjustments  
Background bonuses have been simplified.  

🛡 Harmony of Humanity
🛡 When a shield is generated, it increases by an additional +1.

💪 Dwarven Grit
🛡 Stamina regeneration increased by +1 per second.

🏹 Elven Agility
🛡 Stamina cost for evasion is reduced from 30 to 25.

⚔ Mercenary
🛡 Basic attack damage is increased by 5%.

☠ Pirate
🛡 Critical damage is increased by 7%.

🎭 Charlatan
🛡 Ultimate skill damage is increased by 7%.

🏋 Trainee
🛡 Base HP is increased by 3.

🔍 Archaeologist
🛡 The chance of finding good equipment increases by 5% for each archaeologist.

📖 Sage
🛡 All magic damage is increased by 7%.




Existing Feat Balance Adjustments  
With the addition of the Mastery system, existing feats have had their Attack, Defense, and HP bonus values adjusted.  

Stamina and Evasion Adjustments  
Stamina no longer regenerates quickly.  
However, it now fully regenerates after combat.  

Stamina recovery per second can be increased via the deck-building screen and various feats.  
Some feats now use stamina consumption as a damage resource.  

Thank you.

notes.title: Update_12_18
notes.content:
Hello. Here is the update information.

Feat Adjustments

With the addition of character-specific skills, certain aspects of the existing feat system were no longer a good fit, so we have revised the system.

■ The way damage is applied has been modified to be more intuitive.
■ Feats related to shields have been added.
■ Feats related to barriers have been added.
■ Effects that enhance skill attributes have been added.

The general details are as follows.

Detection
Critical hit rate increases by 5% per level. When a critical hit occurs, there is a 20% chance per level to apply a wound stack.

Super Shot
Attribute: Chain damage increases by 10% per level. (Skills with the Chain attribute cause wound stacks to explode for additional damage)

Strike
Critical hits occurring while a shield is active deal an additional 10% damage.

Knockback
Attacking a giant monster's leg or a fallen enemy deals an additional 5% damage per level. Enemies in the air are also considered.

Finishing Blow
Attribute: Brutality damage increases by 10% per level. (Brutality attribute deals double damage when attacking fallen enemies or based on the topple value of giant monsters)

Defenseless
Attacking from behind with the Brutality attribute increases damage by 15% per level. Airborne status is also considered.

Expose Weakness
Attacking a monster's head or stunned enemies deals an additional 5% damage per level.

Hard Strike
Attribute: Subdue damage increases by 10% per level. (The Subdue attribute deals double damage when attacking stunned enemies or based on the stun value of giant monsters)

Bloodbath
When detonating 5 or more wound stacks at once, restore 1 health per level.

Radiating Warmth
While a shield is active, deals an additional 10% damage per level.

Combat Boost
When a shield is generated through this character's basic attack, their attack power increases by 5% per level for 7 seconds.

Winds of Resurrection
When a shield is removed through this character, restore 1 health per level.

Two-Face
If the shield is fully stacked, it deals an additional 10% damage per level.

Ninja
Back attack bonus increases by 5% per level. Monster aggro is reduced.

Jumper
When attacking in the air, damage increases by 8% per level, and stamina recovers by 8 per level.

Rage Explosion
Roar duration decreases by 20% per level. Afterwards, critical hit rate increases by 10% per level for 20 seconds.

Engineer
Healing and damage from items increase by 10% per level. Bomb damage increases by 20% per level.

Encouragement
If there is a living ally within 2m, damage increases by 10% per level.

Fortune Teller
Each successful basic attack reduces the ultimate skill cooldown by 1% per level.



Additionally, the damage multiplier applied during combat will be displayed in the upper-right corner.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155986/c1c4a142c2b5c4828e620f00069a71fc43cffa49.gif

Thank you.

notes.title: Skeleton King Strategy and New Update Notice
notes.content:
Skeleton King Strategy Guide

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/b12375413db3173ac8ba4e6c41f5e128f763bd48.png
What is the Skeleton King?
The Skeleton King is an undead boss encountered in the fourth quest, with approximately 39,000 health. It attacks with its hands and head, with its head being the primary weak point.

Skeleton King's Abilities

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/4b1771a091c87fcf9dee07c38285478ae90c31e5.png
Smash: Strikes the ground on both sides of the map with its hands, dealing damage.

Center Smash: Strikes the center of the map with its hands, dealing damage.

Sweep: Sweeps its hands across the map, dealing damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/9921bb8acf9f9d37a3d7949f8a7c49c572648453.png
Breath: Releases a dark breath attack. Stick to the sides of the map to avoid damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/392a070ecd9eaea6c7a9e67ecffc1c418200450e.png
Eye Beam: Summons a laser that follows a random player.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/f20565c381adc14d68afb2934ea2b66452391f1e.png
Summon Skeletons: Periodically summons 2-4 skeleton soldiers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/5a140c632dff2d2554bed4e0fcfedff2c9357625.png
Crush: Grabs a random player and squeezes, dealing damage each second. It drops the player if a certain amount of damage is dealt.

Berserk: Enters a rage state after 5 minutes, increasing its damage by 500%.

Recommended Classes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/9f63072630366020f6fc9c2f0eb5a3d241ff2e2d.png
Warrior: Excellent at evading attacks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/515bc1f1e94dfcaae57eb76297855f9a6a382c66.png
Hammerer: Easily hits the exposed head with stun attacks, making them very effective.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/6ce95c3a6fb02f874273a50f3d6007dbe7474cce.png
Wizard: Wide casting range on ultimates, allowing for multi-hit on various parts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/c926bcd7357d2150cb2dcce6ca0e55d91e3c0494.png
Cleric: Can immediately heal from effects like Crush.

Strategy
Basic attacks are manageable, but Eye Beam and Crush deal the most damage.

Use tactical mode to reposition party members during the Eye Beam's targeting period.

Be cautious of the quick damage from Crush. Concentrated damage can quickly free the player from its grasp.

Save the stun gauge to 100% and use it to nullify Eye Beam and Crush when their patterns begin.

Defeat the boss within 5 minutes to avoid its Berserk state. Focus on stunning and dealing damage efficiently to clear the stage.

New Feats (Traits) Added
Existing races and backgrounds used to offer general feats as bonuses, but have now been updated to provide new feats.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/86e13461cd9955736cf6b0b15420f9ba4f954d5f.png
Human: [Agility]
Increases attack power based on the number of equipped items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/cfdf6e0e8b909802558a9fcdccbd6a0e308779de.png
Dwarf: [Alliance]
Increases damage by 3% for each living party member.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/9ff8b287771b67b2e471de1aa636fef8eb070967.png
Elf: [Perceptiveness]
Increases total damage by 1% for each remaining healing potion (up to 15%).

Mercenary: [Iron Wall]
Increases shield defense by 5% for each mercenary.

Pirate: [Underhanded]
Increases critical hit rate by 3% for each pirate.

Charlatan: [Gambling]
Increases ultimate damage by 7% for each charlatan.

Apprentice: [Cooperation]
Increases health by 5 for each apprentice.

Archaeologist: [Harvest]
Increases the chance of finding good equipment by 5% for each archaeologist.

Sage: [Ki Shout]
Increases ranged and magic attack damage by 5% for each sage.

Create unique and efficient parties with these new feats!

2-Player Guide
2-player mode can be selected at the start, and the control range is as follows:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/c81da7b6d62a39dc4a8f4ce3cd5e7e223387aa0f.png
Player 1 controls the first character, and Player 2 controls the second. Tactical mode is locked, and party members cannot be swapped in 2-player mode. Player 2 shares and can control the party member information screen.

Recommended Combination: Blackguard and Rogue
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/be50ffe32f5be9a56d4bcf5bb6a6770c0d5ee8ae.png
Player 1 (Blackguard) taunts with their ultimate,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/af81677db53f1daa6ad044bc66d29d3fdf0cafcc.png
while Player 2 (Rogue) focuses on back attacks, quickly eliminating goblins in normal stages.

Enjoy the game and have fun. Thank you.

notes.title: FINAL KNIGHT v3.42 Update Notes
notes.content:
Party Alignment Skill Update
Final Knight is designed around a core 4-player party system. Players can engage in swap play or 2-player co-op play, while the remaining party members participate in battles as auto-battlers.

As you assemble your 4-person party, you’ll benefit from synergy bonuses and experience unique systems inspired by TRPGs (tabletop role-playing games).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/dc83c9515552b814c9bb540c2f972773c1dd98e8.png
New Alignment System
Each party member has an alignment of law and good/evil. 
The total alignment of the party determines special effects when using ultimate skills. 
The newly added alignments are: Law/Evil, True Neutral, and Chaos/Good. 
Engaging in battles that match your alignment builds stacks. 
Upon meeting certain conditions, triggering an ultimate skill activates a party skill, consuming the stacks and creating various combat effects.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/bf4a3baf28f9db18a94579465485976fcf3d6ad7.png
Skill Attribute Update
Future updates will introduce unique mechanics for each class.

Monster Weakness Update
We are continuously working on improving the visibility of weak points on monster heads and legs.

Raid Style Patterns
We’ve added raid boss patterns to emulate a "WoW-style" instance dungeon experience. This includes patterns where party members must spread out or focus attacks on specific monsters.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/ac47f4830b0a15b66fa74d3d6f0a806e89f71f73.png
Item Changes and Additions
Items have been strategically rebalanced to enhance gameplay. Players can select and enhance items for use in boss fights and regular combat. New items include:

Large Healing Potion
Stamina Potion
Invulnerability Potion


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/38a4e600b3b682e1f93e8ddaeb0f438adb18304c.png
UI Improvements
We have updated the UI to improve visibility and match the game’s atmosphere. This includes modifications to health bars and in-game icons.

Encampment Sound Change
The background music in the encampment has been updated to provide a more immersive experience.

Stage Update
All stages related to tutorials and system guides have been improved.



Future Updates
We are planning to introduce a system where characters can promote and level up their skills upon meeting certain conditions at each stage's level-up segment.


We hope you enjoy these updates and look forward to your continued support.

Thank you.

Hello. We present to you the 3.21 patch notes.

We have completely revamped the party member change screen to be more intuitive.

Graphics

notes.title: FinalKnight v2.6 Update!
notes.content:
Hello! Greetings with the latest update.


Participation Event

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/127c931b579cc53f9f2ab941b065461dc91fb75c.png
Firstly, Final Knight will be participating in G-STAR from November 16 to November 19, 2023.
Gstar 2023 (gravity.co.kr)
https://2023start.gravity.co.kr/#main

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Update

Development Background
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/5a08d79b6ae0cc87248d8bae359ee4ef9e5ee691.png
Final Knight aimed to bring exciting elements from favorite games.

-TRPG combat style from Baldur's Gate 1 & 2,
-Large monsters from Monster Hunter,
-Role distribution of Tank/DPS/Healer from World of Warcraft
-Capcom-style beat 'em up action.


n summary, Final Knight is a party-play, 2D beat 'em up action RPG with a focus on large monster battles, role control, traditional fantasy, and Capcom-style combat.

The result is a game with party play, role separation into Warrior/Melee DPS/Ranged DPS/Healer, 2D beat 'em up XYZ axis gameplay, traditional TRPG atmosphere, a feat system, and a system to pause the game and command each character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/4dbf88de3a5fd54b6c19e056658942b27fda3005.gif
Detailed Content

Art
Ensured visibility of players and allies.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/1c1f155c0bef0b416021bb18334f9b7f217bf193.png
System
Base Camp - Dawn bark

Now, within the body of the Dawn bark, a giant monster Treant, the base camp has been created.

You can create or recreate a party in the base camp.

Through vows in the base camp, you can change the initial feat and determine your gameplay style.

The game's story begins with the base camp as a reference point.






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/6b65d1e00621e070906e4e6c61a7aba64af4e1dd.png
Companion 
4 simultaneous battles are back. All companions auto-attack with basic attacks, but in the strategy screen, you can manually move and specify skills using the cursor.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/d82dc9f3ac3b91ee472b35a2cf76f2ec28b941e1.png
Feat Combination System
Two feats obtained from equipment combine to create a superior feat






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/9931ddb6bba1f35e28b97c551be68a199717c8f8.png
Random Map Placement and Movement System
12 stages are selected from the stage pool and randomly placed on the map. You can explore from the desired area and obtain target equipment and superior feats.






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/01009041d7bc844fe1328ae592ff7e00a5522fd4.png
Contamination System

The total game time is 15 minutes, with 3-5 minutes per stage. As the environment becomes increasingly contaminated, an unspecified dragon, the ally, cannot endure continuous contamination, imposing a time limit.

Normal monsters are inherently mentally contaminated. Using CC like provoke, stun, airborne reduces contamination gauge, allowing for higher damage.

Swiftly clearing stages with high damage is advantageous for farming equipment until the boss battle.






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42985795/a5a9e9fe2e07d0372a7b84080c17180701ff9f06.png
Giant Bosses

More than 4 giant bosses will be added, starting with the final boss, the Skull King. (Reference: Dark Souls 3, High Lord Wolnir)






Additional Stages/b]

Currently, about 14 stages are provided.

Your Help is Essential!

The current build is at an early access level for the first playthrough, excluding the story and unlockable content, with a difficulty set to easy.

notes.title: Final Knight Demo v2.45 Update
notes.content:
Final Knight Demo v2.45 Update

Hello,

After the June NextFest, we have updated the game based on the feedback we received.

Note: There are significant changes to the gameplay mechanics.

[previewyoutube=dyQQJozPx9k;full][/previewyoutube]

Controls:

Skills are now activated using button assignments (QWER or X Y B RT), rather than command inputs.
The character switching system ultimately requires mastery of both characters. If you don't know the commands for one character, there's no reason to switch to them.

It was a challenging decision, but by changing skills from command inputs to button inputs, we've lowered the skill mastery difficulty, encouraging players to switch characters more frequently, utilizing their explosive damage output effectively.

Character Switching:

When the second character's health reaches zero, they will be retired for a certain period.
Corresponding to the new controls, the second character has become a normal companion with health instead of being invincible. You need to control them appropriately. If their health reaches zero, they will be retired and unable to move for a certain period. If the first character's health reaches zero, as before, the game will be over and you'll return to the beginning of that stage.

3rd and 4th Party Members:

Pause the game with RB, move the cursor to summon the 3rd and 4th characters to the desired locations. Each will automatically use their powerful skill and then disappear.
The foundation of Final Knight's combat was inspired by Baldur's Gate 2's party combat. We aimed to implement strategic gameplay by placing party members strategically for battles. However, due to the fast-paced action, fully controlling all four characters became practically challenging. Therefore, only two characters appear in the game. We've added a feature similar to Baldur's Gate 2's spacebar, where you can temporarily pause the game using the RB button. This will help players strategize and summon characters strategically, allowing for concentrated damage output time and experiencing the fun of both TRPG and hack and slash genres.

Monster Mechanics:

We've simplified monster AI, making their movements more intuitive.
Previous versions had a variety of patterns, making monsters move unpredictably, which could be distracting. Now monsters move within predictable ranges, allowing players to focus more on the game.

Visuals:

We've increased the resolution and adjusted the color palette for cleaner pixel art.
Unnecessary screen shaking has been removed. Apologies if the previous version caused discomfort.
UI:
Due to improved screen visibility, we've removed unnecessary UI elements.

Upcoming Features:
Currently, the demo version lasts around 15 minutes and follows a linear path. However, in the future, we plan to reintroduce a TRPG-style "selection" process where players can choose stages and progress while obtaining equipment.

Thank you as always for your support.

notes.title: FINAL KNIGHT Update
notes.content:
Gameplay:
• Players can now choose one of five desired weapons at the start.

Character Swapping:
• When changing to a sub-character, damage dealt is reduced by 50%, but no damage is taken. Instead, 1 HP is lost every 2 seconds (can utilize invincibility frames).

Strikers:
• The 3rd and 4th characters serve as strikers, with their own internal cooldowns for activation.

Difficulty:
• Overall difficulty has been reduced.

UI:
• Increased overall visibility.

Tutorial:
• Improved overall convenience.

Score Competition:
• Defeat the giant ogre faster than others.
